_about: Zap.next for the next/previous channel buttons: the channel delta steps from `from`, inside from's group, wrapping around (like zapping on the TV); a channel with no group zaps among the other channels with no group. `from` is the channel the last tap is heading to while its POST /play is still in flight, not the one GoatTV reports: before this, rapid taps all asked for the same channel (seen on the emulator against the fake TV, 2026-11-22). `taps` chains Zap.next from each tap's result, the order the app sends /play in. Android data/Policies.kt and RemoteCore Policies.swift must both pass every row.
